entries.zh: 淳：淳厚质朴，性情纯良不浇薄（templanza「节制、温和」之德目）
entries.en: temperance; purity and simplicity of character; honest simplicity

entries.zh: 淳朴：质朴敦厚，纯真而不加文饰
entries.en: simple and honest; artless, unadorned (of character)
entries.notes: 西语词头残损含[疑]且闽南音栏有污损记号，据汉字「淳朴」与 Templança 词族推定。

entries.zh: 俭用：节省用度，花销俭省
entries.en: frugal in expenditure; to spend sparingly, economize

entries.zh: 俭使：俭省地使用，省着用钱用物
entries.en: sparing in use; to use or spend frugally

entries.zh: 俭口：省吃俭食，口腹有节
entries.en: frugal and moderate in eating and drinking; sparing at table

entries.zh: 调：调弦、调音（如调校比维拉琴之弦）
entries.en: to tune (an instrument), as one tunes a vihuela; to tighten and adjust the strings

entries.zh: 和：使和谐、应和；调匀搀和
entries.en: to harmonize with, join in accord; to blend and mix evenly

entries.zh: 和调：调和匀称，使之和谐合调
entries.en: to attune and blend harmoniously; harmonious adjustment

entries.zh: 庵：小佛寺；尼庵、修行之所
entries.en: small Buddhist temple; Buddhist nunnery; hermitage

entries.zh: 庙：庙宇，奉祀神明之建筑

entries.notes: 「寺」/Templo 语义确凿，惟闽南音栏声调记号污损，依规程降为 low。

entries.zh: 祠：祠庙，奉祀祖先或有功德者之所
entries.en: ancestral shrine; temple for offerings and worship

entries.zh: 院：寺院、庵院之院宇；僧院（泛指庙院）
entries.en: temple or cloister compound; hall of a monastery
entries.notes: 闽南音栏仅存污损元音、重构为空，据「院」/Templo 推定为寺庵之「院」，材料较薄。

entries.zh: 庵庙：庵与庙之统称，泛指佛道祠庙
entries.en: temples in general; nunneries and shrines; places of worship

entries.zh: 庵寺：庵与寺，佛门庙宇之统称
entries.notes: 语义据「庵寺」/Templo 明确，惟第二音节声调记号污损，降为 low。

entries.zh: 神庙：奉祀神明（偶像）之庙宇
entries.en: temple of the gods; idol temple

entries.zh: 宫观：宫苑中之道观、皇家宫庙
entries.en: palace temple; Daoist temple within the royal palace precincts
entries.notes: 西语词头尾部残损含[疑]（deliao/deliado）且闽南音第二字记号污损，据「宫观」与 Templo de palacio Real 推定。

entries.zh: 生祠：为尚在世之有德有功者所立之祠庙
entries.en: shrine erected to a living person in honor of his good deeds

entries.zh: 祠堂：宗族奉祀祖先之厅堂、家庙
entries.notes: 「祠堂」语义明确，惟第二音节声调记号污损，降为 low。
